correctness.rationale: Wreath-product coordinates imply the complete orbit-profile criterion and class sizes. The exact T_r operator is derived by enumerating replacements in each coordinate. Four or fewer markers give full modular column rank; five markers give mod-prime rank 182 and five independent integer null vectors, fixing rational kernel dimension exactly 5. A direct length-12 pair verifies equal distances and neighbour-displacement multisets but different stabilizer-orbit profiles. Distance-layer induction plus one further refinement round yields dimension-plus-one orbit recovery for four or fewer markers; 3,131 direct marked graphs corroborate the proof.

value.rationale: The first rank loss at five individually marked vertices is a canonical structural identifiability boundary for local Hamming-neighbour distance data. The injective side yields an infinite-family orbit-exact refinement theorem, a uniform dimension-plus-one upper bound and exact class-size formulas, and the noninjective side has a concrete dimension-12 collision. This explains where a natural one-step reconstruction method succeeds and where it must be supplemented; no unproved global five-marker failure is claimed.
